Disney Technology / Research & design system

A shared language for a digital ecosystem.

Research, flows and a design system connecting Disney Technology applications.

UX/UI & Design SystemJuan Carvajal
THE STARTING POINT

Disney Technology

The project sought a holistic view of user interactions across an entertainment ecosystem with multiple applications and professional roles.

PROJECT CONTEXT
01 / The challenge02 / The solution03 / Decisions04 / The impact
01

The challenge

Align different stakeholder needs and establish a consistent experience across at least four suite applications.

02

The solution

The process connected interviews, stakeholder maps, proto-personas and journeys with prototypes and validation. Findings became shared principles, a design system and handoff documentation.

03

Decisions that make the difference

01

Understand roles and needs before defining patterns.

02

Combine synchronous workshops and asynchronous activities to gather perspectives.

03

Document color, typography, interaction and specifications as a system.

04 / The impact

4+ applications, one design language

A shared design foundation to reduce inconsistencies across applications and support design and development. The case does not publish a quantitative impact metric.
